name: Coding (implement in a codebase)
description: Implement or change code in an existing repository — understand the codebase, make the smallest idiomatic change wired end-to-end (including turning a design into working code), verify it runs locally, then commit through the git flow.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When implementing or changing code in an existing repo — a feature, wiring-up, a bug fix, or turning a design into working code — then verifying it runs locally and committing through the git flow. Not for throwaway one-off scripts, and not for reviewing someone else's diff (that is code-review).
